description: Head-to-head falsification summary: four discriminating observables comparing KBC void/MOND model vs TEP isochrony violation. Observables 1, 3, and 4 are independent direct falsification tests. Observable 2 quantifies how the indicator divergence propagates into the peculiar velocity field.

observables.tep_prediction: DMceph < DMtrgb (Cepheid distances compressed by acoustic clock bias)
observables.tep_result: CF4: Δμ = -0.0799 ± 0.0242 mag (3.30σ), N=22, 17/22 Cepheid shorter. Harmonized (R22 vs Freedman 2025): Δμ = -0.0052 ± 0.0268 (0.19σ, N=18). Result does not survive calibration harmonization.

observables.tep_prediction: Cepheid H0 inflates bulk flow; Δv = -3.2·d km/s from indicator divergence (Observable 1)
observables.void_prediction: No calibration dependence (bulk flow is gravitational)
observables.tep_result: Mean BF reduction: 3.3%, RMS shift: 839 km/s, 89% of galaxies |shift|>200 km/s (N=38053)
observables.note: This is a quantification of how the indicator divergence (Observable 1) propagates into the peculiar velocity field, not an independent falsification test.

observables.tep_prediction: Flat H0(z) ≈ 73 for global M_B (zero-point inheritance)
Flat H0(z) for global M_B (zero-point inheritance)
observables.note: The absolute H0 at z > 0.25 is NOT independent — Pantheon+ uses MU_SH0ES with M_B=-19.253 from Cepheid anchors. The meaningful test is the relative evolution (common zero-point cancels). The host-mass dependence of the TEP effect is established in TEP-H0 (Paper 11).

overall_assessment.verdict: TEP strongly favored — majority of observables support TEP; void model falsified on redshift-profile grounds

tep_prediction: Redshift-profile test (Sections 7/8) should favor TEP; indicator divergence (Section 5) is dataset/reduction dependent
void_prediction: The KBC void/MOND model predicts indicator-independent distances, calibration-independent bulk flow, and a gradual H0(z) decline. Falsification occurs if the direct tests favor TEP.
methodology: Four discriminating observables compiled from upstream step results (steps 30, 31, 32, 34, 40). Each observable carries TEP and void predictions, measured results, and significance. Direct falsification tests (observables 1, 3, 4) are weighted most heavily in the overall verdict. Observable 2 is a quantification of the indicator divergence propagation, not an independent test.

provenance.pipeline_block: Block III — TEP reconstruction and synthesis

scientific_context: Head-to-head falsification of the KBC void/MOND model against the TEP isochrony-violation framework. The four observables span indicator-specific distance divergence, bulk-flow calibration sensitivity, the H0(z) redshift profile, and calibration-independent relative evolution. The combined verdict determines whether the void model is falsified.
